items.title: South Korea regulator backs bank-controlled stablecoins after months of dispute
items.summary: Fintech firms could lead stablecoin ventures, but banks would need to own more than half of any issuer.

items.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
items.summary: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.

items.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
items.summary: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team, calls AI a ‘more urgent risk’ than quantum
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation is expanding its security resources as advances in AI raise new concerns about cryptography and software security.
